page.overview:
Who is Sprout?

Sprout is a male Earth pony and supporting character in My Little Pony Generation 5, first appearing as the antagonist of the film My Little Pony: A New Generation. He is the former deputy sheriff of Maretime Bay and son of Phyllis Cloverleaf.

He is called Deputy Sprout and Sprout Cloverleaf in some merchandise and depictions.__TOC__

Sprout's design was finalized by Lea Dabssi; in concept art, Celia Kaspar refers to him as "Sprout Cloverleaf". His name is similar to the G4 Newborn Earth pony Apple Sprout.

In the film My Little Pony: A New Generation, Sprout first appears as a young colt and friend to Sunny Starscout and Hitch Trailblazer. Like most other Earth ponies, Sprout has been taught to view unicorns and Pegasi as dangerous enemies, usually putting him at odds with Sunny's views that all pony races should be friends.
